identity.$comment: Per-role GitHub App identity (operator decision 2026-10-10; migration card per-role-app-identity). Roles: worker, reviewer, merger, ledger, observer. Each role = { appId, installations: {owner|owner/repo: installationId}, key: {name: <keyName>} (resolved on the host as $WE_GITHUB_APP_KEY_DIR/<keyName>.pem; never commit a host path; {file}/{keychain} are host-local back-compat only), botLogin }. NEVER the key itself. An unset role uses today's App (WE_GITHUB_APP_* env), so nothing changes until a role is filled in. Optional callerRoles: {callerName: role} re-routes a caller. Cascade: standard -> platform preference (delivery.identity) -> this file -> env WE_DELIVERY_IDENTITY (JSON; 'none' pins every role to today's App). Trusted bot logins: delivery.botLogins (list; default today's bot + every role's botLogin; env WE_DELIVERY_BOT_LOGINS). See scripts/lib/github-app-identity.mjs.

modes.debug: DEBUG MODE (R817/R823/R826/R852). Diagnose on the live system first (live files, logs, read-only ssh). Make the smallest fix that restores service, load it on the daemon (prototype-load), and prove it LIVE on the blocked case BEFORE any PR (R852, operator: 'confirm it work before pr ... always'). No PR until your report contains the live proof (the blocked PR/run moving, with ET times); if live proof is impossible, say why and stop before the PR. Red-green tests may follow the live fix: commit tests-only first, so red is still observable later. Audit at most 2 rounds (R825); disclose small residual risk as ruled under R825 and file one reinforce-later card. If verify is load-deferred or infra-failed, push the branch as lane/<purpose> and report; do not loop. Never: bypass flags, --force, secrets, pkill.
modes.fast: FAST MODE (R825/R826). One build, ONE verify at the end, audit at most 2 rounds. Small residual risk is ruled under R825, disclosed in the PR body, with one reinforce-later card. If verify is load-deferred, push the branch and report. Open the PR straight to ready-to-merge. No converge loop beyond the configured self-review cap.
modes.full: FULL MODE. The standard process: red-green, verify, the canonical audit NOT WEAKENED (or an operator ruling), PR, review and red-team. Use for product, standards, workflow and trust-boundary changes.
modes.debug-to-merge: DEBUG-TO-MERGE MODE (R1076, rule 31). For a delivery blocker or incident: prove the fix live on the prototype (prototype-load) until the blocked PR merges, THEN open the fix PR. Audit at most 2 rounds; one canonical audit; disclose small residual risk under R825 with one reinforce-later card. No PR before live proof (ET times). Skips: GitHub CI wait for the blocked PR path, extra non-security audit rounds, converge loop. Never: bypass flags, --force, secrets, pkill.

The advisory never accepts review:human. Cascade per key: standard defaults → platform prOwnership preferences → repo declared prOwnership settings → env WE_PR_OWNERSHIP_ADVISORY_ON_HANDOFF (on|off) and WE_PR_OWNERSHIP_UNLABELED_RED (review-label|off). prevention.$comment: batchFiling enables rolling prevention PRs; false restores one PR per card. batchWindowMinutes is the positive integer age in minutes at which a batch seals; batchMaxCards is the positive integer count that seals it early. batchLeaseWaitMinutes is the positive integer wait budget for a detached prevention filer to retry a held batch lease, default 15; it is not part of the policy overlay. Cascade per key: standard defaults (lease wait 15 minutes; other keys from the prevention block in card-batch-policy.json) → platform prevention in delivery-platform-preferences.json (missing means no preference) → repo prevention in declared settings → env WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_FILING (0/1/true/false), WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_WINDOW_MINUTES, WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_MAX_CARDS, WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_LEASE_WAIT_MINUTES. Invalid values are ignored and logged with their layer. Set batchWindowMinutes to 30 to seal every half hour. Set batchLeaseWaitMinutes to 20 (or WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_LEASE_WAIT_MINUTES=20) to wait up to 20 minutes, polling every 30 seconds, before opening the card's own PR if the lease is still held. Operator defaults: enabled, 60 minutes, 25 cards, 15 minutes lease wait.

redTeamGate.$comment: source: both (standard default), check-run (cutover), or drain-scan (rollback). Resolves standard -> platform -> tool -> WE_RED_TEAM_GATE_SOURCE; invalid values are ignored and logged. Check-run recovery waits drain.redTeamPendingMaxMin, then requests once per live head through requestRedTeam, durable before dispatch. Publication guarantee: a round starts only after its in_progress check posts; when a check post and its failure supersede both fail, the writer posts a head-bound commit status on the PR's own context ('red-team/publication #<pr>', so PRs sharing a head never clear each other's hold) that every merge-gate host reads; it is posted before the first check post and cleared only by that PR's confirmed publication, by a trusted author. If every GitHub write fails, only the drain-local hold binds, so CI can still see an older success until writes recover. appId (R905/R907): the trusted red-team check App id (today's WE App) every reader trusts and the writer authors as; resolves standard (none) -> platform -> tool -> WE_APP_ID. The WE_APP_ID repository variable holds the same value as documentation only: it is never read at runtime (every installed App gets HTTP 403 on Actions variables).

redTeam.$comment: statusLabels defaults true (WE_RED_TEAM_STATUS_LABELS override); head-bound derived status only, recorded results remain authoritative. skipCardOnly defaults true; card-only net diffs never schedule a pass.

operatorRulings.$comment: anyState (R903, 2026-11-11: true; set false or WE_RED_TEAM_OPERATOR_RULINGS_ANY_STATE=false for round-cap-only): a human operator's record-red-team-ruling may rule card on a confirmed break in any state, so non-regression breaks are carded without waiting for the round cap. Automation still cannot rule; pending round extensions remain owned by automation.

scripts/settings/review-red-team-on-skip._comment: Recover missing red-team results on already-reviewed heads via the existing review job. Env: WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP (0/1), WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP_RETRY_COOLDOWN_MIN, WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP_STALE_REDISPATCH_DAILY_CAP, WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP_CI_HELD_RECORD_RETRY_MAX (integer 0..10, default 3; 0 disables CI-held record retries).

scripts/settings/tests-first.json.$description: Tests-first delivery. All three build leaves default to true in scripts/lib/tests-first-policy.mjs. Cascade: standard → platform build → repository build → WE_BUILD_REQUIRE_EXECUTABLE_ACCEPTANCE / WE_BUILD_RED_FIRST / WE_BUILD_GUARANTEES_MAP_TO_TESTS (true/false or 1/0). Each source is logged. Set a build leaf here only to override the platform preference. redFirst's commit inspection is advisory; it cannot prove the tests were run red.
